description: Figure 4.1 presents five separate line plots illustrating the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of a Whisper model, with each plot corresponding to a different model size category: “base,” “small,” “medium,” and “large,” with the fifth plot being a placeholder grey box. All plots share the same axes: the x-axis represents “epoch,” ranging from 0 to 6 in linear scale with tick labels at integer intervals, and the y-axis represents “WER,” ranging from 0 to 60 (or 42.5 for the small model) in linear scale with tick labels at regular intervals. The “base” model plot shows four lines: “base AdaloRA_int4” (solid blue line with circle markers) starting at approximately 60 WER and decreasing to about 40 WER; “base AdaloRA_int8” (dashed blue line with circle markers) starting at approximately 58 WER and decreasing to about 38 WER; “base int4” (solid blue line with square markers) starting at approximately 55 WER and decreasing to about 35 WER; “base int8” (dashed blue line with square markers) starting at approximately 53 WER and decreasing to about 33 WER; and “base full” (dotted blue line with triangle markers) starting at approximately 22 WER and decreasing slightly to about 20 WER. The “small” model plot shows three lines: “small AdaloRA_int4” (solid orange line with circle markers) starting at approximately 35 WER and decreasing to about 27 WER; “small AdaloRA_int8” (dashed orange line with circle markers) starting at approximately 33 WER and decreasing to about 25 WER; “small int4” (solid orange line with square markers) starting at approximately 30 WER and decreasing to about 25 WER; and “small int8” (dashed orange line with square markers) starting at approximately 30 WER and decreasing to about 25 WER. The “medium” model plot shows three lines: “medium AdaloRA_int4” (solid green line with circle markers) starting at approximately 30 WER and decreasing to about 15 WER; “medium AdaloRA_int8” (dashed green line with circle markers) starting at approximately 28 WER and decreasing to about 15 WER; “medium int4” (solid green line with square markers) starting at approximately 25 WER and decreasing to about 15 WER; and “medium int8” (dashed green line with square markers) starting at approximately 25 WER and decreasing to about 15 WER. The “large” model plot shows four lines: “large AdaloRA_int4” (solid purple line with circle markers) starting at approximately 27 WER and decreasing to about 10 WER; “large AdaloRA_int8” (dashed purple line with circle markers) starting at approximately 26 WER and decreasing to about 10 WER; “large int4” (solid purple line with square markers) starting at approximately 25 WER and decreasing to about 10 WER; and “large int8” (dashed purple line with square markers) starting at approximately 25 WER and decreasing to about 10 WER. The first plot in the top-left corner is a grey placeholder box with no data or labels.
